single_change_from_v469: Replace pooled E KNN with four context groups followed by exactly one action-nearest prototype per group, and add the exact-zero no_transport prototype to every group. All formulas, folds, gates, C estimator, v169 outputs, and guards otherwise remain unchanged.

failure_analysis.observed: v469 passed fold0. Fold1 failed both no_transport=0.9820668124 and scale_0p4=1.0310244594; fold2 failed scale_0p4=1.0330986200. All overall, uint8, factual, action-control, phase-control, cosine, and nonzero gates passed in folds1 and2.
failure_analysis.mechanism: the pooled 640-sample transport library allowed several prototypes from one visually close context and allowed factual/scale_1p25 prototypes to occupy multiple of the four slots. It omitted the no_transport E=0 anchor. For a small 0.4x request this creates an upward residual-magnitude bias even when the action feature is informative.
failure_analysis.intended_fix: force four distinct visually matched contexts, select at most one prototype within each context using only request-action distance, and include E=0 as a possible prototype. This preserves visual locality while making small-motion retrieval choose a small or zero anchor instead of four pooled large-motion residuals. C and the exact-zero no_transport E path are unchanged, so this change cannot repair fold1 no_transport=0.9820668124; fold1 may remain the single allowed failed fold. The required outcome is to repair the scale_0p4 failure including fold2 and obtain at least four passing folds under the unchanged 4-of-5 gate.

frozen_group_estimator.context_stage: compute mean squared normalized 192D context distance to every fit context; select exactly four distinct contexts by the unchanged v469 ascending tuple (distance, canonical/no_transport action_sha256, context_sha256). The canonical action hash is only a fit-library stable key, never a query feature or branch-identity feature; preserving this tuple makes C_hat and the no_transport candidate bitexact to v469.
frozen_group_estimator.appearance: C_hat is the uniform arithmetic mean of the four selected contexts' C_star maps
frozen_group_estimator.prototype_set_per_context: exactly five stored action/E pairs: factual, no_transport, scale_0p4, scale_1p25, and reverse_direction_0p4; names/ordinals are storage provenance only and are never an input or tie-break
frozen_group_estimator.action_stage: for each of the four selected contexts independently, compute mean squared normalized 54D action distance from the query to all five stored actions; select exactly one prototype by ascending (distance, action_sha256, context_sha256)
frozen_group_estimator.action_prediction: E_hat is the uniform arithmetic mean of the four selected prototype E_star maps; each selected context contributes exactly one map
frozen_group_estimator.no_transport_prediction: if the request action is byte-exact canonical no_transport under the frozen action formula, bypass prototype lookup and set E_hat exact zero
frozen_group_estimator.context_only_control: use the same four selected contexts; for a non-no_transport query, within each context uniformly average all five E_star prototype maps, then uniformly average the four context means; this is exactly 20 equal weights and uses no action distance
frozen_group_estimator.phase_shuffle_control: use the same four contexts and action-stage algorithm, replacing only the query action with the frozen v468 within-episode half-rotation donor action of the same stored sample; retain original query context
frozen_group_estimator.storage: C_star and E_star maps are exact int16; average in float32; no learned network, PCA, ridge, output scale, distance weight, or post-hoc shrinkage
frozen_group_estimator.all200: build one all200 deployment prototype library only after immutable S0 PASS, using identical formulas and five prototypes per context
